narrative.overview:
This records the Services and Contact visual system and shared light header. About adopts its palette and font families while preserving its original structure; its page-specific styles are in `src/styles/aboutPage.css`. The user selected consistency with Services and Contact: a white background, warm text, coral buttons and icons, CreatoDisplay headings and Playfair Display italic emphasis. It documents an inherited system; no new brand persona or creative metaphor was chosen.

The homepage, shared footer, mobile navigation drawer and Services megamenu retain their existing dark contexts. The light page palette does not replace those contexts or the global stylesheet defaults. Sources are `src/pages/{About,Services,Contact}.tsx`, `src/components/layout/{Header,Navigation,Footer}.tsx`, `TemplateContactForm.tsx`, `HomeServicesList.tsx`, `DotLink.tsx`, `TextReveal.tsx` and `public/css/style.css`.
keyCharacteristics: White inner-page canvases with warm ink and secondary body text.
Coral pill actions with dark labels; darker coral for readable links and focus.
Sans-serif headings with italic serif phrase emphasis.
Flat warm panels, fine separators and a green consultation close.
Stacked mobile content that becomes paired columns at desktop widths.

rules.name: The Context Rule
rules.body: Apply light-page colors explicitly within a light surface; preserve the existing dark shell and its light logo variant.

dos: **Do** use the documented light palette and typography when extending About, Services or Contact.
**Do** retain warm-ink labels on coral primary actions and visible contextual keyboard focus.
**Do** preserve stacked mobile layouts, readable body measures and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** preserve existing asset provenance and supplied company content.
donts: **Don't** apply the white inner-page canvas universally to the dark homepage, footer or navigation panels.
**Don't** treat large-heading coral as the default color for small text links; use readable coral in the observed light context.
**Don't** describe the analytics photograph as the team or as newly generated imagery.
**Don't** invent selected, error or interaction states absent from the source.
